Private Events

It’s time to create a unique wine experience just for you, and I, Eynat Klein, will be happy to do it anywhere in Israel and the world.

Private Events

A wine tasting, master class, dinner party, or something completely unusual – the Vino&Co team will bring any fantasy and the wildest dream to life. We can organize an event of any level of complexity – from a small family event to a top-level VIP reception. We work with the best private chefs and wineries, decorators and sound engineers, musicians and venues.

All you need to do is simply tell us your wishes, and we will take care of the rest.
